audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty was described as a generic 'AD assassin' problem with no named mechanism.
audit.why: The actual problem is Darkin Daggers at 900 range sending packmates onto you, plus Eviscerate's 450-range dash on a 7s cooldown at max rank — she reaches you repeatedly, not once.
audit.corrected: Tricky at 7/10 because Eviscerate re-engages every 7-11s and the packmates apply damage you cannot shield off.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers on the last three rows: phases[4..6].side all read 'Skill' while win[4]/win[5] read Naafiri and win[6] read Kassadin. The full-layer whys for rows 4 and 5 described Kassadin taking over, contradicting the content layer.
audit.why: Hounds' Pursuit at 110s rank 1 plus two recasts keeps the all-in hers through level 6 and one item; the flip is the two-item mana spike.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and phases[5].side set to Naafiri with matching whys; phases[6].side set to Kassadin. Content win[] rows were already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit interactions that decide this lane were never stated: The Call of the Pack (W) makes Naafiri untargetable, Eviscerate (E) is also untargetable during the dash, and Hounds' Pursuit (R) can be recast for a shield.
audit.why: Null Sphere is single-target, so an untargetable window makes it fizzle; Riftwalk's damage is area, so it still connects.
audit.corrected: Do not throw Null Sphere at her while The Call of the Pack or Eviscerate is animating — it needs a target and she does not have one. Riftwalk's area damage still lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it.
audit.why: Hounds' Pursuit is 110/95/80s, Eviscerate 11 down to 7s, The Call of the Pack 26 down to 18s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written in; Eviscerate is the punishable one because it is the re-engage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was mentioned only as a trailing clause with a misgendered pronoun.
audit.why: Eviscerate fully heals her packmates on each cast, which is what sustains her chip pressure through an extended trade.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds timing matters because Eviscerate restores the pack every 7-11s.

audit.why: 52.63% across 1978 games is consistent with a lane lost and a game scaled into.
